description:
Property to be sold is located in the TOWNSHIP of MONROE, County of MTDDLESEX, State of New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 7 ANGELINA COURT, MONROE TOWNSHIP, NJ 08831.
BEING KNOWN as LOT 58 BLOCK 148.54 on the official Tax Map of the TOWNSHIP of MONROE.
Dimensions: 0.517 ACRES.
Nearest Cross Street: VENEZIA DRIVE.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Please be advised that definitive occupancy information is not available and Plaintiff
makes no representation regarding occupancy.
Good Faith Estimated Upset: $176,928.35.
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
**If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's attorney.
***After the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
****Subject to a first mortgage held by MERS, INC., AS NOMINEE FOR SUPERIOR MORTGAGE CORP. having an approximate balance of $558,750.00 as of Mortgage Recording dateof August 14, 2006 in Book 11757, Page 371.
